checks.name: fullscreen close/reopen
checks.observation: KDE More Actions Fullscreen supported; reopened Settings fills entire display without frame or panel.

checks.name: minimize/restore
checks.observation: Native minimize hides the view; Alt-Tab restores complete Settings. Earlier taskbar click witness remained desktop and is not accepted as proof of taskbar restore.

checks.name: dirty draft retention and Cancel

checks.name: dropdown placement after native recreation

checks.name: native folder dialog cancellation and owner protection
checks.observation: KDE native folder picker remains visible with its owner when owner close is clicked. Escape cancels picker; Settings remains completely painted with unchanged saved folder. No folder selected/created.

checks.name: final desktop state
checks.observation: All app views closed, owned native session visible through VNC, resident identity and twelve-operation count unchanged.
